proposals.evidence: Full bhalla explicitly lists Bengali bhāla, Oriya bhala/bhalā and Assamese bhāl “good”, with regional short and long vowels. These eastern survey forms continue that good-adjective family. Turner calls the shortening irregular and compares bhadra through *bhadla; the family link retains that qualification and leaves regional borrowing unresolved.
